description: This Java class, DocumentController, provides REST API endpoints for managing project documents in a web application. It supports listing, uploading, downloading, and deleting documents associated with projects.

classes.name: DocumentController
classes.description: REST controller for handling document-related operations for projects, including list, upload, download, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: listForProject
methods.description: Retrieves a list of documents associated with a specific project ID.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading a new document for a specified project, saving it to storage and recording metadata.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Provides a downloadable resource for a document by its ID, with content type detection.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a document by its ID, removing both file and metadata.
